listing.summary: Description: A fleet of (robotic) warships that have quick shields, high flux dissipation, and high flux/power weaponry that make them more suited for hit and run as opposed to frontal attacks. Many of these ships are bumped up technological tiers compared to the vanilla human ship designs.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a faction of robotic warships designed for hit-and-run tactics with quick shields and high flux dissipation.

description:
DSTech Corp Fleet

Description: A fleet of (robotic) warships that have quick shields, high flux dissipation, and high flux/power weaponry that make them more suited for hit and run as opposed to frontal attacks. Many of these ships are bumped up technological tiers compared to the vanilla human ship designs.

Most DSTech ships feature multitudes of light HELR Burst Beam Projectors that function in defensive and offensive applications.

Note: Campaign integrated + Overpowered

Fighters and Corvettes:

Spoiler

Frigates:

Spoiler

Destroyers:

Spoiler

Cruisers:

Spoiler

DOWNLOAD HERE
Installation:
- Remove old copy of the DSTech Corp Fleet mod first
- Unzip to the mods directory of Starfarer

Find them at the DSTech Corp Factory located at the very edge of Corvus! I intend to develop this into a fleshed out faction mod to satisfy my own sense of immersion in Starfarer.

aiDescription: Introduces a fleet of robotic ships featuring quick shields, high flux dissipation, and high flux/power weaponry. These vessels are optimized for hit-and-run combat rather than frontal engagements and often utilize light HELR Burst Beam Projectors. The faction is integrated into the campaign and can be found at the DSTech Corp Factory.
